CS Console Guide

How to read the CS dashboard, add a CS, and keep it up to date.

Every screen is the real CS Console, captured with example data.1Numbers match the notes below each screen.

PART 1

Reading the dashboard

One screen shows one month: the toolbar, summary tiles, then the sidebar and the list.

1.1Whole screen

1.2Language

1.3Toolbar

1.4Summary tiles

1.5Sidebar

One filter at a time. Click another item to switch. Click the same one again, or the status ring at the top, to clear it.

1.6List

CS received in the month you are viewing, newest first.

1.7Carried over

1.8Details

1.9Translations

CS written in Korean appear in English. This is the same CS after clicking Show original.

PART 2

Adding a CS

Open it with + New CS in the toolbar.

2.1The form

2.2Fill in from a Slack message

PART 3

Managing CS

Change the common fields right from the list or the details panel.

3.1Severity in the list

3.2Quick actions in details

The buttons under the details open a small form in place. From left: Change status · Add history · Change owner.

3.3Edit · delete

3.4Reorder or insert history

In the edit form, drag the handle (⠿) on the left of a History line to reorder, and use + to insert a line right below. Add history in details always adds at the end.

3.5Manage owners

Open it with Manage owners next to “By owner” in the sidebar. The list is shared by the team.

PART 4

Finding CS

4.1Filters

Click a status or severity in the tiles, or an issue, severity, device or owner in the sidebar. Below, Hotfix is selected.
